name: Sty Holic
source:
A girl who has lived her whole life without knowing the love of family sought love from her brother, her only immediate family in a distorted way...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ341209.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLSite[/url].]
translation:
一个一生不懂亲情的女孩，以一种扭曲的方式向唯一的亲人哥哥寻求爱……
